beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Year after year, Hannah went to the house of the LORD and came away with an empty lap.

timing.text: Year after year, Hannah went to the house of the LORD and came away with an empty lap.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The other wife mocked her for it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One year at Shiloh, Hannah slipped to the door of the tabernacle and prayed with a voice no one could hear — only her lips moved. This is what she said.

beats.speaker: woman
beats.text: O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid,

beats.text: but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life.

beats.text: Just look at me, she was saying. Remember me. Don't forget me. Give me a son — and I will give him back to You for the whole of his life. She asked for the one thing she wanted most, and promised it away in the same breath.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Eli the priest watched her lips move with no sound coming out, and thought she was drunk.

beats.text: No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
